name: coupon-code-generator
description: Generate batches of unique coupon, gift and redeem codes and printable cards from a small campaign sheet. Set a pattern like XXXX-XXXX, a prefix per batch, and a character set without look-alike letters, with an optional check character so typos are caught. Codes come from a seed, so the same campaign always gives the same codes, and a list of codes you have already issued is never reused. Export a CSV for your shop system and a cards PDF with value, code, expiry and a QR code that can open your redeem page. Runs locally; no coupon service or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 用一张简单的活动批次表，批量生成不重复的优惠码、礼品码、兑换码和可打印的兑换卡。设定码型（如 XXXX-XXXX）、每批的前缀和不含易混字符的字符集，还可以在末尾加校验位，输错能发现。兑换码由种子生成，同一个活动永远得到同样的码；已经发出的码清单也可以选上，绝不会重复。导出给店铺系统用的 CSV，以及印有面值、兑换码、有效期和二维码（可直达兑换页）的兑换卡 PDF。在本地运行，不用发券服务，无需 API 密钥。
